headline: Toyota raises annual profit forecast on strong hybrid demand and weak yen
summary: Toyota Motor Corporation has increased its full-year profit guidance, citing robust demand for hybrid vehicles and the benefit of a weaker yen. The company also reported quarterly earnings that exceeded analyst estimates.
why: Toyota is the world's largest automaker by volume. Its performance is a key indicator for the global automotive sector and the Japanese economy, which relies heavily on export-driven manufacturing.

impacts.name: Toyota Motor Corp
impacts.why: Stronger profit forecasts and earnings beats typically drive share prices higher.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
